meta.name: Bank Value 15Y Strategy
meta.objective: Test the V5 agent and skill workflow by defining a bank-sector value-investing quantitative strategy over the past 15 years, from 2011-07-14 to 2026-07-14.

data.vendor: JoinQuant market and valuation data with reconstructed bank indicators and annual report fallback
data.bank_indicator_policy: Do not use direct JoinQuant bank_indicator. Use reconstructed ratios, ordinary financial statements, and annual-report extraction with source labels.

factors.name: low_price_to_book
factors.definition: Price-to-book ratio using point-in-time market capitalization and latest visible net assets.

factors.name: dividend_yield
factors.definition: Trailing cash dividend yield using only dividends announced before the rebalance date.

factors.name: return_on_equity_ttm
factors.definition: Trailing return on equity from financial statements visible by announcement date.

factors.name: non_performing_loan_ratio
factors.definition: Non-performing loan ratio from reconstructed bank indicators or annual report extraction with explicit source label.

factors.name: provision_coverage_ratio
factors.definition: Provision coverage ratio from reconstructed bank indicators or annual report extraction with explicit source label.

factors.name: core_tier_1_capital_adequacy_ratio
factors.definition: Core tier 1 capital adequacy ratio extracted from bank annual or interim reports and aligned by announcement date.

scoring.value_trap_guard: Require asset-quality composite to be above the universe median before a low-PB stock can enter the final portfolio.

defensive_rule.name: bank_sector_valuation_and_credit_quality_guard
defensive_rule.description: Reduce target exposure by 50% when the bank ETF trades below its 12-month moving average. Individual stop-loss and take-profit rules are not enabled by default because this is a value-investing strategy.

stop_loss_take_profit_policy.reason: Fixed individual price stops can conflict with value-investing logic and require separate evidence before activation.

validation.acceptance_rule: Accept only if factor IC, grouped returns, rolling fold stability, drawdown behavior, and execution stress tests support the financial thesis.
